basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old student from Austin, Texas, currently pursuing a degree in psychology. I have a keen interest in collectibles, particularly those from the Warhammer 40k universe. In my free time, I enjoy exploring music from bands like Bastille and immersing myself in various online communities. I dislike rigid schedules and prefer to engage in activities that allow for creativity and personal expression. I'm typically online during the evenings, especially after my classes or part-time job at a local comic book store. Currently, I'm single and open to meeting new people, especially those who share my niche interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of psychology from my university studies, which I'm passionate about applying to real-world scenarios. My love for Warhammer and collectibles comes from years of self-directed learning and participation in related forums and events. Additionally, I have a growing interest in music, often exploring different genres and artists.
